sources.note: Group-level sketch only (sec. 2.1, pp. 85-87): vowels, consonants, and 2.1.3 Tone: 'The Mambiloid languages are register tone languages, all appearing to have either three or four tones at the lexical level.' Nothing on stress. Table One lists 'Kamkam/Mvanip (100)'; p. 88: 'Information on pluralization is not available for Mvanip.' Author warns 'the vast majority of these languages have not been studied at all'.
